title: deploy-server-git-pull
command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=10 root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 "cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys && git pull origin main 2>&1"

title: deploy-server-git-pull-retry
command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=10 root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 "cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys && git pull origin main 2>&1"

title: deploy-docker-build
command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=30 root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 "cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys/docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build manager machine1 machine2 --no-cache 2>&1 | tail -50"

title: check-build-progress
command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=15 root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 "docker buildx ls 2>&1; echo '---'; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.Size}} {{.CreatedAt}}' | head -10 2>&1"
